lane_title: Geothermal Hydro-Mechanical De-Biased Fault Discovery & Exact Correlation-Free Dual-Head Expected-DTI Fractional Allocation

experiments.name: Zero-Catalogue Dual-Head Multi-Physics Geothermal & Up-Dip Tectono-Geomorphic Ensemble
experiments.emission: Greedy Poisson-disk NMS (d >= 2.8 px, S = 37,654 binary dots, d_vis > 2.0 px)
experiments.hypothesis_tested: De-jittered centerline classification p_phys(x) + exact 300 m kernel self-credit regression q_phys(x) across zero-catalogue multi-physics layers (19 competition bands including b07-b10 seismicity, 1m/10m 3DEP scarps, cross-catchment fluvial chi/ksn wavefronts, 60-deg up-dip hanging-wall gravity/basement pullback, block-deseamed GeoDAWN K/Th/U + RTP oxidation trough + MT clay-cap boiling triad, DOE GDR-1391 3,800 2m temperature probes + geothermometry + sinter/travertine vents + volcanic vents, SGMC pre-Quaternary bedrock reactivation, and Lahontan paleoshoreline + TIGER roadcut suppression) outperforms all prior pure-physics / non-catalogue baselines including Fold-Fair H33-2-B2 and GEMSDOE70 P8.

experiments.name: Out-of-Fold Physics-Guided Minimum-Action Crustal Geodesics, 6-Color Bilateral Relay Tomography & Domain-Calibrated Two-Population Fusion
experiments.catalogue_leakage_control: Strictly computed per fold from fold-visible skeleton V_k and strictly out-of-fold Stage-1 q_phys^(-k); all derived channels gated by Single-Feature Leakage Canary <= 0.90.
experiments.emission: Greedy Poisson-disk NMS (d >= 2.8 px, S = 37,654 binary dots, d_vis > 2.0 px)
experiments.hypothesis_tested: Non-Euclidean minimum-action fracture propagation w(u->v) = ||du||_2 / (0.06 + q_phys^(-k)(v)^0.85) + 6-coloring two-component relay bridge tomography B_bridge(x) + PU radial covariate-shift calibration increases HOLDOUT-DTI across all 4 quadrants over EXP-88-1 at identical S = 37,654 greedy NMS emission while preserving balanced far-field discovery (~48% live mass at d_cat > 15 px, >20% at d_cat > 35 px).

experiments.name: Exact Correlation-Free Dual-Head Expected-DTI Fractional Submodular Allocation via Dinkelbach Lazy CELF + 1-Swap Polish
experiments.surface_frozen_from: EXP-88-2 (zero retraining; pure allocation test at identical S = 37,654 dots)
experiments.emission: Exact Dual-Head Expected-DTI Fractional Optimizer: max_D [(1 - 0.2*lambda)*sum_g p(g)*max_{x in D} k(||x-g||_2) - 0.2*lambda*sum_{x in D}(1 - q(x))] + post-greedy 1-swap local search (S = 37,654 binary dots, d_cat > 2.0 px)
experiments.hypothesis_tested: Replacing heuristic greedy NMS with exact zero-independence dual-head Expected-DTI fractional optimization + 1-swap local search improves HOLDOUT-DTI across all 4 quadrants on both Seed 20 and Seed 30 without any spatial independence assumption.
